item.title: Downingtown West shades Spring-Ford in OT to reach district semifinals
item.description: DOWNINGTOWN — It may have been a battle, but Downingtown West’s dream of a treble is still alive and it took one of their seniors coming alive to keep it so. Ellie Dexter scored all of her 10 points in the fourth quarter and overtime as the third-seeded Whippets staved off No. 6 Spring-Ford, 44-41 in overtime in a District 1 6A quarterfinal at Wagner Gymnasium on Saturday afternoon. item.description: RADNOR — For the first three periods of Saturday’s District 1 4A championship game at Harriton HS, the Pope John Paul II boys basketball team put on a clinic.
